name: Dingxian Huang
bio_short: PhD student studying neural oscillations and multisensory perception after completing master's training at BSD Lab (2023–2026).
bio_long: I completed my master's training at BSD Lab from 2023 to 2026 and began my PhD studies in neuroscience in 2026. My research focuses on neural oscillations and their role in perception, using EEG to investigate multisensory integration, particularly in audiotactile illusions. I am interested in how brain rhythms shape perceptual experience.
